clauses.text:
Section 1. T he N ational Com m ission for Industrial Peace is hereby 
abolished and E xecutive Order N o. 11710 of A pril 4 , 1973, and Execu­
tiv e O rder N o. 11729 o f July 12, 1973, are hereby revoked.

clauses.label: Sec. 2.
clauses.text:
Sec. 2. T h e Secretary of the Treasury shall be responsible for d osin g 
th e affairs of the Com m ission, and for the com pletion of any functions  
that rem ain to be perform ed under the Federal Advisory Com m ittee A ct 
w ith respect to the Com m ission and its report. In  preparing th e report 
required by section 6(b)  o f th at A ct, the Secretary shall consult w ith the 
D irector o f the Federal M ediation and C onciliation Service.
